newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - More bids rolled to December.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - More bids rolled to December.

text.p: More basis bids for hard red winter wheat were rolled out to the KCBT December contract from the September contract, grain dealers in Kansas and Oklahoma said Tuesday.

Dealers said farmer selling of HRW wheat remained mostly slack over the weekend and Tuesday morning. But one south central Kansas dealer said he was starting to receive "significant" loads of new crop corn from western Kansas.
Meanwhile, more rain fell on the Oklahoma Panhandle and portions of central and western Kansas over the weekend and Monday.

"Parts of the Panhandle received two to three inches overnight. I think some (wheat producers) are going to start complaining soon that they can't get into their fields" to plant HRW wheat, an Oklahoma dealer said.
Basis values are quoted against KCBT wheat, cash dollars/bu.

Kansas City 12 ovr Sep 12 ovr Sep 4.8050
